title: レースの中に、ドリームを

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The title of Umamusume of the Year is a great honor bestowed on the Umamusume who shines brightest in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In order to bring happiness to a great number of people, Taiki Shuttle resolves to seize this crown for herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thus begins her spirited sprint toward a grand dream!
